fixes.title: Red night mode still paints the accent-colour swatches in full-saturation cyan, green and magenta
fixes.summary: Under Theme = Red night the Accent color row no longer renders SettingsColorPicker at all, so none of the seven literal-colour circles reach the screen. The row stays, with a subtitle that states the truth found while fixing it: resolveSkotiqThemeData returns the fixed SkotiqTheme.redNight BEFORE it parses the accent, so the picker was also completely inert there - seven bright taps that changed nothing. The stored accent is still named so the row is not just missing.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/settings/appearance_red_night_accent_test.dart -> 'red night renders no accent swatch at all', 'red night says the accent does not apply', 'dark still offers the swatches'
fixes.revert_check: Replaced `if (settings.theme == 'redNight')` (appearance_settings.dart:79) with `if (false)` -> both red-night tests FAILED (all 7 ValueKey('settings-color-#...') swatches found again); restored -> 3/3 pass.
fixes.caveats: SettingsColorPicker itself (settings_widgets/settings_color_and_path_inputs.dart) is outside this agent's ownership, so the fix is at the call site rather than inside the picker.

fixes.title: Importing a detailed .hor horizon silently collapses it to 8 sector maxima - a single tree blocks a whole 45-degree sector
fixes.summary: The import now states what it is about to store and the user confirms it. Before writing, a dialog reports the sample count ('36 samples read'), that Skotiq stores eight 45-degree sectors and keeps only the tallest sample in each, an upper bound on how many survive ('At most 8 of the 36 survive' - an exact discarded count would be a lie whenever samples pile up in one sector), the CONSEQUENCE ('part of a sector that is really clear will be treated as blocked and the planner will skip targets there'), and the eight values that will actually be stored (S 29 degrees etc). Cancel leaves the existing hand-tuned mask untouched - previously the import overwrote it with no confirmation at all. The success message now reads 'Horizon imported from <file> - 36 samples reduced to 8 compass sectors (tallest obstruction per sector)'. The Local Horizon Mask section itself now carries the same statement permanently, so the resolution is visible where the eight values are edited, not only in a snackbar that disappears.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/settings/location_horizon_import_disclosure_test.dart -> 'the import states the sample count and what it drops', 'the import shows the eight values it is about to store', 'cancelling leaves the existing mask untouched', 'accepting stores the sectors and the message reports the reduction', 'a single-sample file is not reported as dropping samples'
fixes.revert_check: Severed the production call site: replaced the whole `final confirmed = await _confirmHorizonReduction(...)` block in _importHorizonFile with `const confirmed = true;` -> ALL 5 disclosure tests FAILED; restored -> 5/5 pass, plus location_horizon_import_authority_test.dart 3/3 and location_settings_truth_test.dart 11/11 (26 tests in total across the location + appearance + file-path suites, and the 46-test broader settings batch).
fixes.caveats: The 8-sector reduction itself is NOT removed: HorizonProfile.fromSamples/parseHorizonText and the horizonDirections model live in packages/skotiq_core (outside this agent's ownership) and every consumer - planner, Tonight, planetarium - reads the same 8 values. Storing a full-resolution profile is a core + schema change.
fixes.needs_shared_change: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/settings_provider.dart: HorizonProfile is 8 fixed compass points; the scheduler already has a samples-based HorizonProfile (src/services/scheduler/horizon_profile.dart) with a DB table behind getHorizonProfiles(). Pointing the Location editor and horizonProfileProvider at that model would keep an imported 1-degree survey intact instead of reducing it.

fixes.title: Automatic backups are ON by default and write to a folder the Files & Storage page never names and offers no way to change
fixes.summary: Files & Storage > Application Data now carries a 'Backups' row that names the directory BackupService actually writes to - resolved by asking the service itself (backupServiceProvider.getBackupDirectory()), so the row cannot drift from the real path or from an injected override - and states that automatic backups are written there beside the database and that 'Maximum backups' DELETES the oldest bundles from that same folder. An 'Open folder' button reveals it (Copy path on mobile, where there is no file manager); the default revealer creates the directory first because it is created lazily by the first backup and every desktop file manager fails silently on a path that does not exist. If the path cannot be resolved the row says so and still states the retention policy, and no button is offered that would do nothing.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/settings/file_path_backup_folder_test.dart -> 'the backup folder is named on the page', 'the row says retention deletes from that folder', 'the folder can be opened from the row', 'an unresolvable folder still states the retention policy'
fixes.revert_check: Deleted the production call site `_BackupFolderRow(isMobile: isMobile)` from the Application Data section in file_path_settings.dart (leaving the widget class and both providers in place) -> ALL 4 tests FAILED; restored -> 4/4 pass, and the pre-existing file_path_settings_authority_test.dart still passes.
fixes.caveats: PARTIAL: the folder is disclosed but still not CHANGEABLE. The finding also asked for a browse control so backups can go on the drive the user actually backs up. That needs a new setting plus wiring through BackupService (packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/backup_service.dart), both outside this agent's ownership; the row therefore states the location follows the database folder rather than offering a false affordance. The path half of this finding (the old ~/Documents leak that ignored SKOTIQ_DATABASE_DIR) was already fixed before this wave and was NOT re-fixed.
fixes.needs_shared_change: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/backup_service.dart + app_settings_state: add a persisted backup-directory setting, default it to resolveDefaultBackupDirectory(), and pass it as BackupService.backupDirectoryProvider so the new row can gain a browse button. Also: packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/settings/settings_search_index.g.dart should be regenerated (dart run tools/production/settings_search_index_gen.dart) after this wave's settings-widget edits land - it is a shared generated artifact and regenerating it mid-wave would race the other agents.
